description: This file defines an abstract class 'ScopedTransactionsTestRunner' that provides various methods for testing transactional operations on grains within the Orleans framework. The class manages transaction scopes, performs actions, and asserts expected behaviors regarding transaction success or failure.

classes.name: ScopedTransactionsTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods to execute and verify transaction scenarios on grains, including creating transactions, nested transactions, and handling expected failures.

methods.name: CreateTransactionScopeAndSetValue
methods.description: Creates a transaction scope and sets a grain's value, asserting that no exception is thrown.

methods.name: CreateTransactionScopeAndSetValueWithFailure
methods.description: Creates a transaction scope where the grain operation is expected to throw an 'OrleansTransactionAbortedException'.

methods.name: CreateTransactionScopeAndSetValueAndAssert
methods.description: Creates a transaction scope, sets a grain's value, and asserts that the value is correctly set.

methods.name: CreateNestedTransactionScopeAndSetValueAndInnerFailAndAssert
methods.description: Creates a nested transaction, forces a failure in the inner transaction, and asserts the outer transaction's behavior and final grain state.
